name: Slot Machine
description: Each column spins through random characters like a slot-machine reel before locking on the target. Columns stagger left-to-right so the board settles in a satisfying cascade.
author: FiestaBoard

spin_frames.title: Spin frames per column
spin_frames.description: How many random-character frames each column shows before locking on the target.

column_stagger.title: Column stagger (frames)
column_stagger.description: How many frames later each column starts locking, relative to the previous column. 0 = all columns lock simultaneously; higher values produce a left-to-right cascade.

frame_interval_ms.title: Delay between frames (ms)
frame_interval_ms.description: Time to pause between each step. Smaller = faster spin.

seed.title: Random seed
seed.description: Set to a fixed integer for deterministic playback (useful for previews). Leave 0 for a fresh random spin each run.
